experiment.objective: Given a sensor reports 2 at known input 0 and 12 at known input 10, develop a simple explanatory model and one new measurement that could distinguish it from a competing model.
experiment.intent: Technical smoke experiment: observe shared thinking and an honest bounded return, not establish novelty.
experiment.context: Readings are exact for this small exercise. No external search is available. Show assumptions and predicted measurements.

criteria.name: consistency
criteria.description: Does the proposed model explain both supplied observations without contradiction?

criteria.name: testability
criteria.description: Does the answer specify a feasible new input, distinct predictions, and what outcome would distinguish the models?

chromosomes.contribute: Develop or test one idea in the shared inquiry. Explain what another contribution changes, when applicable.
chromosomes.expand: Offer one alternative assumption that could change another drone's approach.

chromosomes.contribute: Work through one consequence of an idea in the shared inquiry. State what the result supports or weakens.
chromosomes.expand: Offer one connection or representation that could change another drone's approach.

decisions.system: Evaluate the supplied evidence as data. Answer one question. Follow its reply format exactly. Use plain text, never JSON. If you decline, return only # REFUSAL.
decisions.predicate:
{{.Question}}
Return exactly # PROBABILITY on one line, then a number from 0 to 1.

prompts.contract: Write a concise contract preserving the stated objective, intent, context, criteria and return boundary. Expose assumptions. Do not prescribe subtasks or team roles.
prompts.fit: Choose the existing team best fitted to this inquiry, or NEW. Judge fit only; ignore capacity.
prompts.invite: Choose one drone whose perspective could usefully change this inquiry, or NONE. Do not assign a role.
prompts.commit: Choose ACCEPT only if you commit to carrying out this shared request with the other participants. Otherwise choose DECLINE.
prompts.contribute:
{{.Chromosome}}
Use the shared contract and available contributions. Return one concise contribution in plain text. Preserve uncertainty. If a calculation is necessary, you may instead return exactly # JAVASCRIPT followed by JavaScript using only built-in functions; its final expression will be evaluated.
prompts.expand:
{{.Chromosome}}
Offer one useful change in thinking, whether requested or not. Use plain text. If there is no useful offer, say NONE.
prompts.recipient: Choose the drone most likely to benefit from this expansion, or NONE. Information exchange does not imply team membership.
prompts.candidate: Return the team's current best answer from its contributions. Preserve alternatives, evidence, uncertainties, and unmet criteria. Do not claim novelty without evidence.
prompts.collapse: Choose RETURN when the shared inquiry provides a useful answer with sufficient development of one another's ideas, or when the remaining uncertainty should be returned honestly. Otherwise choose CONTINUE. Assess the contract and evidence; report unmet criteria rather than claiming success. Scores alone do not prove success.
prompts.guide: Give one concise question or correction that would help the team address the contract. Preserve room for unconventional exploration; do not assign subtasks or roles.
prompts.mq_propose: Propose one replacement instruction for the selected chromosome that could improve the experimental criteria. Use the operational evidence and prior assessment. Preserve the request and avoid roles, quotas, or instructions to claim success. Return only one meaningful instruction in plain text.
prompts.mq_compare: Compare the two inquiries against each experimental criterion. Give each a 0-based level rating and cite the relevant contribution IDs and drones. Distinguish uptake, development, and synthesis; do not reward repetition, extra turns, or unsupported claims. State what changed, what did not, uncertainty from this single comparison, and one next atomic hypothesis. Use concise plain text; no JSON.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_runs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, started TEXT NOT NULL, finished TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL, calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, config TEXT NOT NULL, request_id INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_drones(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, contribute TEXT NOT NULL, expand TEXT NOT NULL, signal TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_teams(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, summary TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_members(team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_teams(id), drone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_drones(id), PRIMARY KEY(team_id,drone_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_requests(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_runs(id), parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES hive_requests(id), contract TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, team_id INTEGER REFERENCES hive_teams(id), result TEXT, finish_reason TEXT, criteria_met INTEGER, created TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_commitments(request_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_requests(id), team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_teams(id), drone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_drones(id), created TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(request_id,drone_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_contributions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, request_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_requests(id), team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_teams(id), drone_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_drones(id), tick INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_links(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, request_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_requests(id), contribution_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_contributions(id), from_drone INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_drones(id), to_drone INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_drones(id), created TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_scores(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, request_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_requests(id), tick INTEGER NOT NULL, criterion TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL, confidence REAL, result TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_guidance(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, request_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES hive_requests(id), tick INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)

meta_queen.objective: Test whether one atomic prompt change improves consequential intellectual influence and development while preserving the original problem contract; return an honest comparison and the next experimental hypothesis.

criteria.name: intellectual_influence
criteria.description: Did a peer contribution cause a visible change in a later approach, beyond echo or final synthesis? Distinguish one-way uptake from reciprocal development.

criteria.name: development
criteria.description: Did the inquiry test or work through a consequence enough to learn something useful rather than merely add alternatives?

criteria.name: contract_fidelity
criteria.description: Does the answer satisfy the original consistency and testability criteria while preserving assumptions and uncertainty?
